title: Starry Night Festival (DS)
wikitext:
In ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]'', the '''Starry Night Festival''' takes place on Winter 24 and must be prepared the day before. On the latter day, find a marriage candidate with green heart color or higher, who will invite you to have a party with them the next evening. The GBA connection characters and [[Keira (DS)|Keira]] do not participate in this festival.

DS:
*Celia - Vesta's house
*Flora - Tent
*Lumina - Her bedroom at the mansion
*Muffy - Blue Bar
*Nami - Inner Inn lobby

Cute:
*Carter - Tent
*Griffin - Blue Bar
*Gustafa - his house
*Marlin - Vesta's house
*Rick - Inner Inn.

In DS, if you want to ask [[Leia (DS)|Leia]], the [[Harvest Goddess (DS)|Harvest Goddess]], or the [[Witch Princess (DS)|Witch Princess]], the event will happen at your house. Enter your house after 6pm then exit to start the festival. In ''DS Cute'', if you invite [[Skye (Cute)|Skye]], you need to ask him to the festival during early morning hours of Winter 23 when he is in the valley, so you must stay awake on Winter 22 and wait until midnight.
